Tecsack Software defines “Confidential Information” as any and all information, know-how, and data
– technical or non-technical – concerning matters affecting the Company's business, operations, or
products, including drawings, plans, and processes, disclosed or provided by the Company to an
employee in any form (oral, written, graphic, photographic, or electronic).
a. Hold Confidential Information in strict confidenceand exercise a reasonable degree of care
b. Not disclose or divulge Confidential Informationto others, directly or indirectly, unless first
authorised to do so by the Company.
c. Not reproduce Confidential Information, noruse it commercially or for any purpose other
than the performance of their duties for the Company.
d. Deliver to the Company any drawings, notes,documents, equipment, and materials received
from or originating from its activities, upon request or upon termination of employment.
• The Company has the sole right to determinethe treatment of any information that is part- or

project-specific and received from an employee, including the right to keep it as a trade
secret, use and disclose it, or file patent or copyright registrations in its own name.
• The Employee agrees not to file any patentapplications claiming information, developments,

or inventions arising from, or that could not have been made without, access to Confidential
Information.
• Should any provision of this Agreement be heldinvalid, illegal, or unenforceable by a court of

competent jurisdiction, that provision shall be severed, and all other provisions shall continue
in accordance with the intentions of the parties.
• Nothing in this Agreement is a promise of continuedemployment for any specific period, and
nothing modifies or alters the at-will nature of an employee's employment.

Tecsack enforces a stringent password policy to protect company systems and data. The essential
components are:
1. Password complexity: passwords must be at least8 characters long and contain a
combination of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and special symbols.
2. Password expiry: passwords must be changed every90 days, and employees cannot reuse
3. Account lockout: if an employee enters an incorrectpassword five times, their account will
be locked out for a period of time.
4. Password storage: Tecsack stores passwords usinga secure hash algorithm, so that even if
the password database is compromised, attackers cannot easily access the passwords.
5. Password sharing: employees are not permittedto share their passwords with anyone else

All Tecsack employees are required to follow these password practices to ensure the security of
Tecsack systems and data.

Tecsack Software considers its physical, digital, intellectual, and technological assets to be important
resources of the organization. All employees are expected to use Company assets responsibly,
securely, and exclusively for authorized business purposes.
Company assets may include, but are not limited to:
● Laptops, desktops, monitors, mobile devices, and other hardware.
● Software licenses, development tools, and subscriptions.
● Company email accounts, cloud platforms, servers, databases, and repositories.
● Company documents, technical information, source code, credentials, and other confidential
● Office equipment, furniture, networking equipment, and other physical property.
● Intellectual property, designs, documentation, business information, and client-related
Employees must use Company assets primarily for legitimate business activities and only for
Employees are responsible for taking reasonable care of the Company assets assigned to them.
● Keep assigned equipment in good working condition.
● Follow Company security and IT guidelines.
● Protect devices, passwords, credentials, and confidential information from unauthorized
● Immediately report loss, theft, accidental damage, malfunction, or security incidents to the
● Avoid installing unauthorized software or modifying Company systems without approval.
● Not lend Company equipment, accounts, credentials, or other resources to unauthorized
Any incident involving Company property must be reported as soon as reasonably possible.
● The condition and age of the asset.
● Whether the employee followed applicable procedures.
● Whether the damage resulted from normal use, negligence, or intentional misconduct.
● The reasonable value of the loss or repair.
Employees may be required to provide an explanation or cooperate with an internal investigation.

Tecsack Software maintains a structured notice-period process to ensure a smooth transition of
responsibilities, knowledge, Company assets, and client commitments when an employee leaves the
organization.

The applicable notice period shall be determined by the employee's employment agreement,
applicable Company policies, and relevant laws and regulations.
An employee who wishes to resign must submit a formal resignation through the prescribed
Company process and notify their Supervisor and HR.
The resignation will be reviewed and formally acknowledged by the Company. The applicable notice
period will be calculated from the date specified in the Company's resignation acknowledgement or
as otherwise provided in the employee's employment agreement.
Unless otherwise specified in the employee's employment agreement or applicable policy, Tecsack's
Employees are expected to continue performing their assigned responsibilities professionally
The Company may, where appropriate and subject to applicable terms and approvals:
● Waive part or all of the notice period.
● Modify the notice-period arrangement based on business requirements.
● Apply contractual provisions relating to notice-period compensation or recovery where legally
Employees serving notice are expected to:
● Continue their normal duties and responsibilities.
● Maintain professional conduct and work performance.
● Complete assigned tasks and pending deliverables.
● Document ongoing work and technical processes.
● Transfer relevant knowledge to designated team members.
● Provide required project, database, code, documentation, and system handover.
● Assist with the transition of client or internal responsibilities.
● Return Company assets and confidential information.
● Complete required exit and clearance procedures.

This policy is applicable to all employees of Tecsack Software, including Trainees and Full-time
Employees. There are two types of leave: Casual Leave and Sick Leave.

Purpose: to grant days off from work to an employee in the event of personal work or commitments.
Casual leave should be planned in advance.
• The Employee is entitled to 12 calendar daysof paid Casual Leave every year. The year for
leave accounting is the financial year, i.e. April to March.
• Casual leave is credited every quarter of theyear.
• Unutilised Casual Leave is not carried forwardto the next financial year.
• Casual leave should be applied in the systemat least five working days before the day of
leave, and informed by email to the Supervisor and HR team.
• An employee cannot apply for more than threecontinuous days of casual leave.
• An employee cannot apply for more than twocasual leaves in a month.

• Employees serving their Notice Period cannotavail Casual Leave, even if they have

Purpose: to grant days off from work to an employee in the event of illness or injury, for medical
treatment and/or recuperation.

• Sick leave is credited on a pro-rata basisfor trainees and probationers, on completion of the

first calendar quarter after their date of joining, and thereafter at the end of each subsequent

• Unutilised sick leave may be carried forwardto the next financial year, up to a maximum

• Sick leave must be availed only for an employee'sown medical reasons.
